summary: The recorded base reproduces the source defect: Spark2_5Attention.forward hardcodes sigmoid even when the config carries gate_attn_act_mode='silu'. At the exact candidate commit, the mode is explicitly preserved by Spark2_5Config, propagated through Spark2_5DecoderLayer, and applied in the real attention forward path with sigmoid and silu branches plus ValueError for unsupported values. Candidate regression tests and independent CPU and gfx950 GPU numerical checks passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression against the exact candidate test; collection failed because the base implementation has no _apply_gate_activation helper. Independent base inspection also confirmed the real forward method hardcodes torch.sigmoid and differs from the SiLU reference by max_abs_diff=19.0 on [-20,-2,0,2,20].
Candidate regression suite: config default/override, exact float32 sigmoid and SiLU activation references, and unsupported-mode rejection; 4 tests passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Verified imports came from /job/repo/python; exact CPU parity for float16, bfloat16, and float32 inputs; invalid modes '', 'SiLU', 'gelu', and None rejected; decoder propagated silu; exact GPU parity on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-a0fac3663983/venv/bin/python < independent Spark2_5Attention.forward harness (candidate checkout; output retained at /job/review-evidence-j-a0fac3663983/candidate-forward-path.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: Exercised the real forward gating block on CPU and GPU with two heads and negative/positive gate scores. Sigmoid and SiLU matched independent PyTorch references exactly, and gelu raised ValueError.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the helper and actual Spark2_5Attention.forward gating path on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, reported as gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: No Spark-X2.5 checkpoint weights were available, so no full-model generation or semantic-accuracy comparison was run.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture is a different architecture and would not qualify this Spark2.5 model-path issue, so it was not used.
No native source changed in the candidate; repository-environment.json reports no prepared native artifact, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
Only the assigned single AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) was exercised; no multi-GPU or multi-node claim is made.
